users_type_chk.name: users_type_chk
users_type_chk.value: (user_type = 'platform' AND vendor_id IS NULL) OR (user_type = 'vendor' AND vendor_id IS NOT NULL)

product_variants_vendor_barcode_uq.name: product_variants_vendor_barcode_uq
product_variants_vendor_barcode_uq.where: "product_variants"."barcode" IS NOT NULL AND "product_variants"."deleted_at" IS NULL

product_variants_price_chk.name: product_variants_price_chk
product_variants_price_chk.value: (mrp_minor IS NULL OR mrp_minor >= 0) AND (selling_price_minor IS NULL OR selling_price_minor >= 0)

marketplace_listings_override_chk.name: marketplace_listings_override_chk
marketplace_listings_override_chk.value: (buffer_override IS NULL OR buffer_override >= 0) AND (max_quantity_override IS NULL OR max_quantity_override >= 0)

inventory_qty_chk.name: inventory_qty_chk
inventory_qty_chk.value: quantity_on_hand >= 0 AND quantity_reserved >= 0 AND quantity_reserved <= quantity_on_hand AND quantity_incoming >= 0 AND quantity_damaged >= 0 AND quantity_returned >= 0

order_items_qty_chk.name: order_items_qty_chk
order_items_qty_chk.value: quantity > 0 AND reserved_quantity >= 0 AND reserved_quantity <= quantity

attribute_mappings_shape_chk.name: attribute_mappings_shape_chk
attribute_mappings_shape_chk.value: (source_type = 'core_field' AND core_field IS NOT NULL) OR (source_type = 'attribute' AND attribute_id IS NOT NULL) OR (source_type = 'static' AND static_value IS NOT NULL)

channel_inventory_policies_range_chk.name: channel_inventory_policies_range_chk
channel_inventory_policies_range_chk.value: safety_buffer >= 0 AND allocation_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND (max_quantity IS NULL OR max_quantity >= 0)

inventory_movements_nonzero_chk.name: inventory_movements_nonzero_chk
inventory_movements_nonzero_chk.value: delta_on_hand <> 0 OR delta_reserved <> 0 OR delta_incoming <> 0 OR delta_damaged <> 0 OR delta_returned <> 0

stock_transfer_items_qty_chk.name: stock_transfer_items_qty_chk
stock_transfer_items_qty_chk.value: quantity > 0 AND received_quantity >= 0 AND received_quantity <= quantity

inbound_shipment_items_qty_chk.name: inbound_shipment_items_qty_chk
inbound_shipment_items_qty_chk.value: expected_quantity > 0 AND received_quantity >= 0 AND damaged_quantity >= 0 AND damaged_quantity <= received_quantity

fulfillment_items_qty_chk.name: fulfillment_items_qty_chk
fulfillment_items_qty_chk.value: quantity > 0 AND picked_quantity >= 0 AND packed_quantity >= 0 AND short_quantity >= 0 AND picked_quantity + short_quantity <= quantity AND packed_quantity <= picked_quantity

packages_dims_chk.name: packages_dims_chk
packages_dims_chk.value: (weight_grams IS NULL OR weight_grams > 0) AND (length_mm IS NULL OR length_mm > 0) AND (width_mm IS NULL OR width_mm > 0) AND (height_mm IS NULL OR height_mm > 0)

pick_tasks_qty_chk.name: pick_tasks_qty_chk
pick_tasks_qty_chk.value: quantity > 0 AND picked_quantity >= 0 AND picked_quantity <= quantity

return_items_qty_chk.name: return_items_qty_chk
return_items_qty_chk.value: quantity > 0 AND received_quantity >= 0 AND received_quantity <= quantity AND dispositioned_quantity >= 0 AND dispositioned_quantity <= received_quantity AND restocked_quantity >= 0 AND restocked_quantity <= dispositioned_quantity

return_items_condition_chk.name: return_items_condition_chk
return_items_condition_chk.value: condition IS NULL OR condition IN ('sellable', 'damaged', 'defective', 'wrong_item', 'missing')

return_items_disposition_chk.name: return_items_disposition_chk
return_items_disposition_chk.value: disposition IS NULL OR disposition IN ('restock', 'damaged', 'dispose', 'return_to_vendor', 'quarantine')

business_rules_window_chk.name: business_rules_window_chk
business_rules_window_chk.value: starts_at IS NULL OR ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at

marketplace_prices_amounts_chk.name: marketplace_prices_amounts_chk
marketplace_prices_amounts_chk.value: (price_minor IS NULL OR price_minor > 0) AND (mrp_minor IS NULL OR mrp_minor > 0) AND (sale_price_minor IS NULL OR sale_price_minor > 0)

marketplace_prices_window_chk.name: marketplace_prices_window_chk
marketplace_prices_window_chk.value: sale_starts_at IS NULL OR sale_ends_at IS NULL OR sale_ends_at > sale_starts_at

notifications_dedupe_uq.name: notifications_dedupe_uq
notifications_dedupe_uq.where: "notifications"."dedupe_key" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."read_at" IS NULL

order_financials_nonneg_chk.name: order_financials_nonneg_chk
order_financials_nonneg_chk.value: (marketplace_fee_minor IS NULL OR marketplace_fee_minor >= 0) AND (penalty_minor IS NULL OR penalty_minor >= 0) AND (other_cost_minor IS NULL OR other_cost_minor >= 0)
